name: Gemini Code Assist
official_status_notes: Google's Gemini-powered IDE assistant (VS Code + JetBrains) with a free tier for individuals. Verify current quota/plan details on the official site.
pricing_summary: Free tier; enterprise tier via Google Cloud.
best_for: Gemini users who want a no-cost IDE assistant for personal projects.
strengths: Free tier, strong Gemini models, chat + completions, some agentic features.
weaknesses: Less transparent BYOK; confusion with Gemini CLI feature set.
